Name: Game Port
Description: Frontend port the game client connects to

Name: Web Frontend Port
Description: Plain HTTP port for login, account creation and the dashboard. Clients reach it through the HTTPS port, not directly

Name: SiteConfig Port
Description: HTTP port of the built-in web server serving SiteConfig.xml. Port-patched clients use it via -siteconfigport; stock clients need public port 80 forwarded here

Name: Login Port
Description: HTTPS login port of the built-in web server, proxied to the Web Frontend Port. Port-patched clients use it directly; stock clients need public port 443 forwarded here
